sources.primary_title: 2026 is the Saudi 'Year of AI'. SAMAI 2 launches with 11 ministries.
sources.verified_angle_summary: Moving beyond the broad "Year of AI" declaration, Saudi Arabia has operationalized its AI ambitions with the launch of the SAMAI 2 (Saudi Arabia Mastering AI) initiative. This concrete procurement framework involves 11 government ministries—including health, education, energy, and defense—each running specific AI acquisition programs anchored by the Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA). This development represents a massive, structured procurement window for international AI vendors, shifting the narrative from strategic vision to immediate, large-scale government deployment. The initiative aligns closely with the compute infrastructure being deployed by HUMAIN and establishes a clear operational governance framework following recent responsible AI policy consultations.
sources.verified_key_facts: The SAMAI 2 (Saudi Arabia Mastering AI, second phase) initiative launched with 11 participating ministries; Participating ministries cover health, education, transport, environment, energy, justice, interior, foreign affairs, the Royal Court, and the Council of Ministers' general secretariat; Each ministry will run its own AI procurement program under the SAMAI 2 framework; The initiative is anchored by SDAIA and aligns with HUMAIN's compute infrastructure; A public consultation on a Responsible AI Policy closed on May 3, 2026, signaling an upcoming operational governance framework; The Saudi Cabinet officially designated 2026 as the 'Year of AI' in March 2026.
